title: Rhythmical Massage Compared With Heart Rate Variability Biofeedback in Women With Menstrual Pain (Dysmenorrhea)
brief_summary: A study to explore whether rhythmical massage and heart rate variability biofeedback can help to reduce pain in women suffering from menstrual pain (dysmenorrhea).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least one year of primary dysmenorrhea (physician-confirmed).
* Written informed consent (also from parents/legal guardians of underage girls).
* Menarche at least one year ago.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Secondary dysmenorrhea.
* Participation in another study.
* Mental retardation.
* Addiction.
